description: Traffic Management — Key Corridor — Performance Report is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Traffic Volume for Key Brisbane Corridors. Includes traffic volumes, travel times and incidents. This dataset will no longer be updated. Data is being published in a new format in a new dataset called Traffic Management, Key Corridor, Monthly Performance Report. Information on Traffic Management is available on the Brisbane City Council website. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are road, traffic, transport, travel. The portal shows 2026-06-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
